notes.title: Coffin of Ashes – Update #7 Spanish Support, Last Chance of Raffle!
notes.notes:
Thanks to the efforts of the Spanish translator Greg, Coffin of Ashes now supports Spanish language! We hope all the gamers who speak Spanish will enjoy this game.

Here are the patch notes:

- Added Spanish language support.
- Fixed some inappropriate translations for English and Japanese.
- Updated the engine.

Our special sale is going to end in around 24 hours, this is the last time to pick our titles for up to 60% off. Please check them here:

http://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Angels%20Blue%20Digital%20Entertainment

If you enjoy free things, we are also giving away 5 free copies of the Angels Blue Games Bundle. https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1390/Angels_Blue_Games/

To opt in to the giveaway, please do the following:

1. Follow @digitalezstudio on Twitter. https://twitter.com/digitalezstudio
2. Retweet this tweet: https://twitter.com/digitalezstudio/status/1043522642509099009

We'll randomly pick 5 lucky winners on the 4th of October, and the keys will be sent via private message on Twitter.

Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Coffin of Ashes – Update #6 and Christmas Sale
notes.notes:
An update for Coffin of Ashes has been released. Here are the patch notes:

- Added WASD keys support as we were requested.
- Fixed the issue that purple bead disappears when leaving the room.
- Fixed some translation mistakes.
- Some other small fixes.

During Steam's Christmas event all our catalog will be on sale up to 60% off! For details please visit the link here:

http://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Angels%20Blue%20Digital%20Entertainment

Wish you have a merry Christmas!

notes.title: Coffin of Ashes – Update #1
notes.notes:
An update for Coffin of Ashes has been released. Here are the patch notes:

- Fixed the achievement “Crystal Memories” not unlocking in some situations.
- Slightly decreased the evil spirits’ speed so it is now easier to escape from them in Hard difficulty.
- Fixed the wall-hacking issue of the first floor.
- Other small fixes.

If you find anymore bugs, please don’t hesitate to report them here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/546080/discussions/0/152391285463007976/

Thanks for your support! ːlismileː
